en: Jill will do whatever you say.
I'm so sleepy
Good morning, little miss.
Good morning, mister.
Who are you, mister?
Hmm. I'm Jill.
My mama's Martha. She works at the factory.
I see. Listen to your mama and be a good
girl, now.
Okay. Bye-bye, mister.
Oh, mister. Good morning again.
Morning, mister.
Mama gets up really early, you know.
So Jill gets up early too. I'm sleepy...
Misteeer!
Good morning. How are you? Jill's fine!
Hey, mister, come play with Jill sometime.
Mama's busy, so she can't play with me.
And Auntie Rhoda, who I love, is tired too.
So come play with Jill sometime!
Good evening, little miss.
It's this dark. Shouldn't you go home?
Uh-huh, it's okay. Mama doesn't get home
till after dark either. Jill hates being alone.
Being home all by myself is boring.
Is your mama at work?
Uh-huh, that's right. She's at work.
So on Sundays, Jill plays with
Auntie Rhoda.
Are you going home too, mister, 'cause it's dark?
Good evening, mister.
Jill's going home in a little while.
'Cause Mama's coming home.
So it's all right.
Oh, mister!
Good evening. Are you going home now?
Hey, hey, mister, what do you do for work?
<It's a secret>
<I'm a detective>
Awww, it's a secret? Meanie.
Tell me next time, okay?
You're a detective? Wow, how neat!
You solve all kinds of crimes, right?
Tell Jill about your cases. Okay?
Are you playing here too, mister?
Sure, wanna play with Jill?
Mister, what's your name?
Nice to meet you, Jill.
Hmmm... That's a hard name.
Never mind, I'll just call you mister.
Huh? Are you playing here too, mister?
Next time I'll invite Auntie Rhoda too.
Auntie can only play on Sundays.
That's sad, isn't it?
Let's play together!
Welcome, mister! Hello.
You know, I can't let you in the house, but
let's talk out here, you and Jill. Okay?
I wish Auntie Rhoda would hurry home.
She's nicer than Mama, and prettier,
and she plays with Jill.
Will you play with us too sometime, mister?
Welcome! Will you talk with Jill here again?
Say, mister, do you have any friends?
Jill only has a few.
But it's okay. I've got Auntie Rhoda.
She's really, really nice. I love her!
I'll let you meet her too, mister.
Hello, mister.
Mama says she's been tired lately.
So Jill's being good. Aren't I a good girl?
Let's play in the square sometime, okay?
Auntie's coming too!
